result.instructions: Tools for Simplecast, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my episodes got the most downloads in the last 30 days?"; "Show downloads per week for my podcast this quarter."; "Which podcast apps and countries do my listeners use?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Simplecast data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run simplecast_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simplecast_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simplecast_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. simplecast_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simplecast_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Get the user and account that own the API token, with links to its podcasts and subscriptions. Simplecast API: GET /current_user.

tools.name: simplecast_list_podcasts
tools.title: List podcasts
tools.description: List the podcasts in the account (title, status, id). Good first call to find a podcast id. Simplecast API: GET /podcasts.

tools.name: simplecast_get_podcast
tools.title: Get a podcast
tools.description: Get one podcast with its metadata, site, language and links. Simplecast API: GET /podcasts/{podcast_id}.

tools.name: simplecast_list_episodes
tools.title: List episodes of a podcast
tools.description: List the episodes of a podcast, with title, status, season and publish date. Simplecast API: GET /podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes.

sort.description: Sort field: title, number, custom_url, published_at, created_at or updated_at (default latest).

tools.name: simplecast_get_episode
tools.title: Get an episode
tools.description: Get one episode with its description, audio, season, number and publish state. Simplecast API: GET /episodes/{episode_id}.

tools.name: simplecast_get_episode_markers
tools.title: List ad markers of an episode
tools.description: List the ad markers (pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll) of an episode. Simplecast API: GET /episodes/{episode_id}/markers.

annotations.title: List ad markers of an episode

tools.name: simplecast_list_seasons
tools.title: List seasons of a podcast
tools.description: List the seasons of a podcast. Simplecast API: GET /podcasts/{podcast_id}/seasons.

tools.name: simplecast_list_season_episodes
tools.title: List episodes of a season
tools.description: List the episodes of one season. Simplecast API: GET /seasons/{season_id}/episodes.

tools.name: simplecast_list_distribution_channels
tools.title: List distribution channels of a podcast
tools.description: List where a podcast is distributed (Apple Podcasts, Spotify and others) with the channel links. Simplecast API: GET /podcasts/{podcast_id}/distribution_channels.

annotations.title: List distribution channels of a podcast

tools.name: simplecast_get_downloads
tools.title: Get download analytics
tools.description: Get the number of downloads over time for a podcast or an episode. Simplecast API: GET /analytics/downloads.

podcast_id.description: Podcast UUID. Give this or episode_id.

episode_id.description: Episode UUID. Give this or podcast_id.

start_date.description: Start date, ISO 8601 (default: the publish date).

interval.description: Group the data by day, week or month.

tools.name: simplecast_get_listeners
tools.title: Get unique listener analytics
tools.description: Get the number of unique listeners over time for a podcast or an episode. Simplecast API: GET /analytics/listeners.

podcast_id.description: Podcast UUID. Give this or episode_id.

episode_id.description: Episode UUID. Give this or podcast_id.

start_date.description: Start date, ISO 8601 (default: the publish date).

interval.description: Group the data by day, week or month.

tools.name: simplecast_get_episode_analytics
tools.title: Get analytics grouped by episode
tools.description: Get download analytics for a podcast, one row per episode. Pass episode_ids to limit the rows. Simplecast API: GET /analytics/episodes.

start_date.description: Start date, ISO 8601 (default: the publish date).

interval.description: Group the data by day, week or month.

tools.name: simplecast_get_top_episodes
tools.title: Get the top 10 episodes
tools.description: Get the ten most downloaded episodes of a podcast. Simplecast API: GET /analytics/episodes/top_10.

start_date.description: Start date, ISO 8601 (default: the publish date).

tools.name: simplecast_get_location_analytics
tools.title: Get download analytics by location
tools.description: Get downloads by country for a podcast or an episode. Pass country (a country id from an earlier result) to get its states. Simplecast API: GET /analytics/location.

podcast_id.description: Podcast UUID. Give this or episode_id.

episode_id.description: Episode UUID. Give this or podcast_id.

country.description: Country id from an earlier result, to list its states.

start_date.description: Start date, ISO 8601 (default: the publish date).

tools.name: simplecast_get_technology_analytics
tools.title: Get download analytics by technology
tools.description: Get downloads split by one technology dimension: podcast app, browser, device class, device, listening method, network type, operating system, provider or web player. Simplecast API: GET /analytics/technology/{dimension}.

podcast_id.description: Podcast UUID. Give this or episode_id.

episode_id.description: Episode UUID. Give this or podcast_id.

start_date.description: Start date, ISO 8601 (default: the publish date).

tools.name: simplecast_get_time_of_week
tools.title: Get downloads by time of week
tools.description: Get when listeners download a podcast, by day of week and hour. Simplecast API: GET /analytics/time_of_week.

annotations.title: Get downloads by time of week
